title: Understand Multisite Replication and Searchability
objectives: Verify actual state through a separate inspection or query.

tasks.instruction: Erie retains its actual profile topology. The manager has explicit site1/site2 RF and SF policies. Advance until each bucket has available searchable copies in both sites. Inspect origin and total constraints.

Use the clearly labeled lab site-fault control in Indexer clustering to stop site1 indexers. Query all three source_logs records from the surviving site. Restore site1 with the same control, advance repair, and verify both-site searchable coverage. This control is not a native Splunk command.

hints: Inspect running versus disk source and use the correct component.
Keep the fixture clock paused and advance deliberately to observe transitions.

references.purpose: Searchable restart and available copy preflight
Deployer source, target and merge_to_default behavior

checks.label: Cross-site searchable copies and restored site fault

feedback.success: Verified operational state and independent evidence are retained in this isolated attempt.
feedback.incomplete: Inspect current source, service state, operation receipts and replica data.
